display_long_description:
Zombie City MR  is an action-packed zombie survival experience that puts you directly in the middle of a terrifying undead outbreak. Step into a dangerous world overrun by zombies and use your skills, weapons, and quick reflexes to survive wave after wave of relentless enemies.

As the infection spreads, increasingly powerful and dangerous zombies will appear. Fight your way through the chaos, defeat challenging enemies, and survive for as long as possible. Every wave becomes more difficult, forcing you to react quickly, manage your resources, and choose your strategy carefully.

The ultimate challenge awaits at the end: the final boss. This powerful enemy will test everything you have learned throughout the game. Defeat the boss and find your way to safety to achieve victory. But be careful—one wrong move could end your survival.

With immersive MR gameplay, intense combat, challenging enemies, and endless waves of zombies, Zombie City VR delivers an exciting survival experience where every moment can mean the difference between escaping alive and becoming part of the undead.

Fight. Survive. Defeat the boss. Escape—or die trying.
